note: What tools/ci/gate.ps1 runs per tier (PLAN 1.9). Each step runs one tools/ci script in its own PowerShell. '{milestone}' becomes the milestone (-Gate M<n>, else from the branch or the tags). gateJson: the script writes artifacts/gates/<id>.json itself; otherwise gate.ps1 records its exit code and log. heavy: gate.ps1 pauses before it while the user plays. perf: needs mains power (otherwise 'invalid'). oracle: skipped by -SkipOracle. hard false: reported, never fails the tier. headline: at the milestone tier only headline steps decide (PLAN 1.10). requiresParam: skipped (with a note) until the script has that switch. 'milestones' adds steps per milestone to a tier. pending: the step's test or scenario is not on main yet; such steps are hard false (reported, never deciding) until the integrator drops pending and the hard flag when the lane lands (M3 placeholders from card T3.7).
